plugin.name: Neko Deskmate
plugin.description: Watches your local coding agents: broadcasts and explains when approval, completion, failure or a stall happens, and lets you approve or reject inside N.E.K.O.
entry.status.name: Plugin Status
entry.status.description: Returns the plugin's own state (uptime / stage / adapter readiness). Agent observation runs in a background poll every 3 seconds; use scan_now to trigger one immediately.
entry.dump_events.name: Dump Recent Events
entry.dump_events.description: Reads the observation sources once and returns the most recent N unified events, to confirm the parsing is correct.
entry.scan_now.name: Scan Now
entry.scan_now.description: Reads the observation sources once and runs the rules, returning event count / hit count / expected broadcast count and the rule breakdown. Read-only diagnostics: it sends no broadcast.
